newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Santos says has new gas discovery.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Santos says has new gas discovery.

text.p: Oil and gas producer Santos Ltd said on Wednesday it had a new gas pool discovery in the South Australian section of the Cooper/Eromanga basins.
The discovery, Swan Lake 1, flowed gas at 232,500 cubic metres per day (8.2 million cubic feet per day) from reservoir sands in the interval 2493-2592 metres.
The Swan Lake gas field is about six km east of the Meranji gas field and 30 km north of the Moomba gas plant.
A number of follow-up drilling opportunities exist on the Swan Lake structure.
Santos is the operator and has a 75.25 percent stake in the Merrimelia-Innamincka block, in the Swan lake is situated.
Exxon Corp unit Delhi Petroleum Pty Ltd owns 15 percent, Boral Ltd five percent and Crusader Resources, a unit of Clyde Petroleum Plc, 4.75 percent.
Santos shares closed three cents down at A$4.94.
